item.title: Incarico post-doc: Postdoctoral assignment - Ancient and Modern Cultures and Languages of Africa and Western Cental Asia (Univ. VENEZIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-23 13:00
Institution: Univ. VENEZIA, Venezia - Venice
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/STAA-01 Culture e lingue antiche e moderne dell'africa e dell'asia occidentale e centrale

This project proposes an exploration of the conceptions of the water cycle and the environment preserved in Arabic sources composed from the twelfth century onwards, during the period commonly defined as post-classical. Although hydraulic engineering in the Arab-Islamic context has been the subject of numerous studies, a history of hydrological thought remains to be written for the centuries following the twelfth. Here, hydrological thought is understood both as systemic reflection on water within the global environment (hydrological cycle, water balance) and as the study of specific phenomena related to it, such as precipitation and its relationship with orography, groundwater and karst…

item.description:

Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/LIFI-01 Linguistica e filologia italiana

The research activity includes reviewing literature on Northern Italo-Romance vernacular inscriptions, specifically Gallo-Italic varieties, from the 13th to 15th centuries, conducting in situ surveys, managing data entry and cataloguing, as well as producing the scientific edition and linguistic commentary of the collected texts. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Design, methodological supervision, for Italian Sign Language assessment and certification. (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-05 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/GLOT-01 Glottologia e linguistica

The research concerns the design, methodological coordination, and psychometric and statistical validation of tools for the assessment and certification of proficiency in Italian Sign Language (LIS). The activities will include defining the validation design, overseeing data collection and quality-control procedures, and applying psychometric methods and advanced statistical models to analyse reliability, validity, internal consistency, and item quality. They will also include the development of standardised protocols, technical and scientific reports, and operational recommendations to ensure fairness, accuracy, and comparability in the measurement of language proficiency.

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: ERC MUSICA FRANCA - Literary and musical connections between Old French and Middle High German Lyrics (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-13 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/GERM-01 Filologie, lingue, letterature e culture germaniche

The work will be complementary to the ERC project MUSICA FRANCA and will contribute to the research strand dedicated to the study of literary, musical, and cultural connections between France and Central and Eastern Europe, with a particular focus on the lyric poetry of the Middle High German *Minnesänger*. Activities will be carried out on-site at the project laboratory located within the Department, in close collaboration with the team. These will include participating in the digital edition of *trouvère* lyric poetry, contributing to the development of the project’s digital platform, and preparing a monograph aligned with the project’s objectives.

item.description:

The research will focus on building SAIL’s textual corpus for its first historical phase, through a survey of Spanish texts representing the Italian landscape between the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries and spanning different textual genres (memoirs, autobiographies, correspondence, as well as pre-periodical), based on archival research in Spanish and Italian institutions. The analysis of selected case studies will also contribute to an initial mapping of the places represented, recurring motifs, and representational techniques, with a view to defining the expressive ‘code’ of landscape representation.
